summary: __thiscall boolean linked-list lookup. Searches a singly-linked list for a node whose ID field (node data at +92, i.e. offset 0x5C) equals the requested ID a2. On entry the traversal cursor at this+0x20 is reset to the head pointer held at this+0x18, then walked via the next-node pointer at +4 until the ID matches. Returns 1 when a match is found, 0 when a2 is -1, the head is null, or traversal ends without a match. The legacy ABI label is 'Linked_List_Search_by_ID'.

local_names.this: linked-list container holding head (this+0x18) and traversal cursor (this+0x20)
local_names.a2: node ID to search for; -1 is an invalid key
local_names.v4: current node data pointer, dereferenced from the cursor head
local_names.v5: cursor value used to advance to the next node
local_names.v6: updated cursor used for the next iteration

operations.description: Search key -1 (a2 == -1) is rejected outright and returns 0
Seed the traversal: read the head pointer from this+0x18 (this[6]) and reset the traversal cursor this+0x20 (this[8]) to it
Only proceed when the head pointer v3 is non-null and the node data pointer *v3 (v4) is non-null; otherwise return 0 (empty list)
Walk the list while the current node's ID field at data offset 0x5C (node data +92) does not equal a2
Advance the traversal cursor: read this+0x20, follow the next-node pointer at +4, store the result back into this+0x20, and load the next node's data pointer for the next iteration
Return 1 when a node whose ID at +92 matches a2 is found
Return 0 when the cursor becomes null mid-traversal (end of list); the function is invoked from MemoryAllocation_5160 (00405160)
